title: Fung Ching

page_data.en:
C: I. D.
F. O. REG
No. 254
Date 16/4/27

Shanghai Municipal Council.

April 18th 191 cl.

POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
Reports as of bomb explosions were heard about
8.30 p.m. 12th instant and about 3.45 a.m. 13th instant.
The first report which was only faint appeared to come
from a south-westerly direction and the second, which
was loud appeared to come from the north west of the
Chinese City. The cause of the reports has not yet
been ascertained.
Several people removed from the City to the
Settlement yesterday.
Two fires occurred in the City last night. The first
started about midnight in a house near the West Gate,
and the second about 12.15 a.m. in a house near the
Small East Gate. It is suspected that the rebels
are responsible for causing these fires.
It is reported that the rebels are experiencing
difficulty in their attempt to turn over the City
Police who are said to be well in hand and loyal.
It is reported that the Shanghai Hangchow Nanking
Railway Co has refused a request made by the Shanghai
and Woosung Military authorities to carry Government
troops to Chekiang.
It is reported that a battle has occurred between
loyalists and rebels at Fung Ching 木風陳 in which the
former suffered considerably.
It is reported that General Yang has
received a report from the Central Government saying
that the rumour of Chekiang having declared independence
is not true. In consequence of this General Yang
has sent four detectives to Hangchow to ascertain how
things are there.
The local military Authorities have taken charge
of the telegraphic office on the S.H.N.R. (South Station).
It is reported that there is unrest among the
troops at Woosung especially the gunners. Three
warships went from the Arsenal to Woosung yesterday
forenoon.
It is reported that Tang Shao Yi has approached
General Yang on behalf of the rebels. The latter
told Tang that he had better square Deputy Military
Governor Lu first.

C: I. D.
F. O. REG
第 254 号
日期 1927年4月16日

上海工部局。

191 年 4 月 18 日。

警务处，
（侦探股。）

先生：
据报，本月 12 日晚约 8 时 30 分及本月 13 日凌晨约 3 时 45 分，听到炸弹爆炸声。第一次报告的声音微弱，似乎来自西南方向；第二次声音响亮，似乎来自华界西北方向。尚未查明这些声响的原因。
昨日有数人从华界迁入租界。
昨晚华界发生两起火灾。第一起于午夜左右在西门附近的一所房屋内起火，第二起于凌晨 12 时 15 分左右在小东门附近的一所房屋内起火。怀疑系叛乱分子纵火所致。
据报，叛乱分子在试图策反华界警察时遇到困难，据悉该等警察管控良好且忠诚。
据报，沪杭甬铁路公司拒绝了上海和吴淞军事当局提出的将军队运往浙江的请求。
据报，忠诚派与叛乱分子在木風陳 (音译) 发生战斗，前者遭受重大损失。
据报，杨将军收到中央政府的一份报告，称浙江宣布独立的谣言不实。因此，杨将军已派遣四名侦探前往杭州，以查明当地情况。
当地军事当局已接管沪宁铁路（南站）的电报局。
据报，吴淞驻军中存在不安情绪，尤其是炮兵。昨天上午，三艘军舰从兵工厂驶往吴淞。
据报，唐绍仪代表叛乱分子接触了杨将军。后者告诉唐，他最好先与卢副督军达成和解。

No.
G. I. D.
F. O. REG
No. 254
Date
Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)
191
2
It is said that Cantonese merchants in Shanghai
are giving financial assistance to the rebels.
The rebels intend to send some men to Dalny to
purchase arms with part of the funds raised.
Owing to the arrest of a police detective
by the Chapei Military Authorities, bad feeling
exists at present between the police and soldiers
in that district.
It is reported that the rebels here intend to
issue military notes soon.
It is reported that the rebels held a meeting
in No.56 Rue Soong Chan about 12 m.n. 12th instant.
One hundred coolies employed in mills
in Gordon Road district some of whom are
ex soldiers failed to turn up on April 12th.
It is said that these coolies have been
enrolled as rebels for some time.
They have returned and are offering themselves
for work this morning.
Your Obedient Servant,
Chief Detective Inspector.
Captain Superintendent of Police.
Entered records Apl. 13.
Seen by C.C.P.
Copy sent to S.V.C.

编号
G. I. D.
F. O. REG
第 254 号
日期
上海工部局。
（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股。）
191
2
据说在上海的广东商人正在向叛乱分子提供财政援助。
叛乱分子打算用筹集的部分资金派人前往大连购买武器。
由于闸北军事当局逮捕了一名警务侦探，目前该地区警民之间关系恶劣。
据报，此地的叛乱分子打算不久后发行军用票。
据报，叛乱分子于本月 12 日午夜 12 点左右在宋园路 56 号举行会议。
戈登路地区纱厂雇佣的一百名苦力，其中一些是退伍士兵，在 4 月 12 日未去上工。
据说这些苦力已被招募为叛乱分子多时。
他们已于今晨返回并主动要求复工。
您忠实的仆人，
总探长。
警务总监。
记录录入时间：4 月 13 日。
已由 C.C.P. 阅知。
副本已送交 S.V.C.
